wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 06-001 wires the vanilla R_ExecuteSetViewSize derivation, the status-bar rectangle, the active-view rectangle, and the canonical 90-degree clip-angle FOV into a single frozen VanillaViewSetup artifact. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/viewSetup.ts imports the read-only computeViewport helper from src/render/projection.ts plus the SCREENWIDTH/SCREENHEIGHT/SBARHEIGHT/FIELDOFVIEW/MIN_SETBLOCKS/MAX_SETBLOCKS constants without modifying them. The wrapper does not touch the filesystem or the FFI surface; every return value is frozen at the top level and inside each nested rectangle.
